about: Input for scripts/screenshots/draft-copy.mjs: facts and limits only. The prose comes from the model, then the Humanizer pass, then Jasper. Every fact below is something the editor does today or is a known gap (blockedBy); a headline must not promise more than its fact.
rules: English. Direct, specific, no fluff, no AI-sounding phrasing, no exclamation marks.
No numbers, percentages, speed or size claims, no comparisons with other products, no superlatives (best, fastest, most).
Do not mention AI, models, cloud, accounts or invites. Never write 'invite to sign'.
headline: at most 6 words. sub: at most 12 words, may be empty. caption: at most 200 characters, one plain sentence saying what the screenshot shows.
Markdown export and tables to Excel are labelled Preview in the app: the caption must say Preview.
